app_concept: A developer-grade, desktop-first AI QA engineering companion inspired by BrowserStack Test Companion, Linear, and VS Code. It pairs an autonomous AI agent with a live browser execution window, interactive DevTools inspector, and actionable failure cockpit.

theme.style_archetype: High-Density IDE & Developer Tools (Obsidian / Neon Cyber-Tactical)

typography.font_family_sans: Geist Variable, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Geist Mono, monospace

chrome.top_window_bar: Fixed 36px top titlebar with macOS window control dots, project switcher dropdown, live agent status indicator, token usage counter, and action launcher.
chrome.bottom_status_bar: Fixed 24px bottom bar with active git branch, connection ping, browser engine badge (Chromium/Playwright), and active session ID.
chrome.left_nav_rail: Compact 56px expanded to 180px sidebar with navigation items: Workspace/Projects, Agent Live Workbench, Test Suites, Test Runs, Findings Inbox, Settings.

workspace_3_pane.panel_left_chat: Agent Chat & Command Panel (width 320px-400px): handles prompt input, streaming agent logs, thought process cards, approval dialogs, and quick action chips.
workspace_3_pane.panel_center_browser: Live Simulated Browser (flex-1): realistic browser chrome (URL bar, back/forward, refresh, tabs, viewport toggle), rendered interactive target website, real-time agent cursor, animated target click ripples, and text inputs.
workspace_3_pane.panel_right_inspector: DevTools Inspector Panel (width 320px-420px): tabs for DOM Tree, Accessibility Tree, Network Waterfall, Console Output, and Computed Selectors.
workspace_3_pane.panel_bottom_timeline: Agent Execution Scrubber (height 140px): interactive timeline of agent steps (Navigate, Click, Type, Assert, Screenshot) sync-linked with the live browser viewport.

page_views.title: Agent Live Workbench
page_views.description: Main 3-pane live agent workspace for watching and guiding AI browser automation in real time.

page_views.title: Test Suites & Specs
page_views.description: Catalog of automated test specs with AI auto-generation, assertions editor, and schedule triggers.

page_views.title: Test Runs & Analytics
page_views.description: Execution dashboard featuring pass/fail rate charts, flaky test analysis, and run execution history.

page_views.title: Findings & Bug Intelligence
page_views.description: Interactive inbox of visual regressions, A11y violations, JS errors with AI root-cause analysis, and 'Apply Fix' action drawer.

page_views.title: Companion Settings
page_views.description: Configuration for agent model (Claude 3.7 / GPT-4o), browser viewport sizes, network throttling, API keys, and webhooks.

key_components.agent_status_pill: Pulsing pill with states: 'Thinking' (Purple animation), 'Planning' (Blue pulse), 'Executing Action' (Cyan active ring), 'Human Approval Required' (Amber badge), 'Completed' (Emerald check).
key_components.simulated_browser_window: Crisp dark browser frame with tabs, SSL indicator, live editable fake address bar, action overlay showing current step, moving laser cursor, and target bounding-box highlight.
key_components.approval_dialog_card: Human-in-the-loop card in chat requiring explicit user approval before performing high-risk browser actions (e.g. submitting payments, deleting items, or submitting forms).
key_components.quick_action_chips: Action chips: 'Explore website', 'Regression Test', 'Accessibility Audit', 'Find Broken Links', 'Generate Playwright Spec', 'Fix Failing Step'.
key_components.failure_cockpit_drawer: Side drawer opened from Findings/Test Runs with side-by-side screenshot diffs, DOM mutation diffs, AI failure diagnosis, and one-click 'Apply Auto-Fix' button.

motion_and_interactions.cursor_animation: Smooth CSS spring transition tracking x/y coordinates across the simulated viewport with a 300ms ripple ring on click.
motion_and_interactions.typing_simulation: Realistic character-by-character typing overlay inside active fake input elements in the live browser view.
motion_and_interactions.streaming_logs: Smooth auto-scroll for agent thought logs with typewriter effect for incoming Markdown response text.
motion_and_interactions.pane_resizing: Snappy drag handles with hover highlight and active drag state visual indicators.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and status indicators MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='chat-input-send-button', data-testid='live-browser-url-bar', data-testid='approval-approve-btn').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: All text elements adhere to minimum APCA/WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces (`#0B0D13` and `#12151E`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow dark desktop app/IDE styling rules. Use 1px crisp borders (border-white/10), dark surfaces (#0B0D13, #12151E), and high-density typography (text-xs for labels, font-mono for DOM/code).
Ensure the simulated browser component has animated cursor movements, target highlight rectangles, typing overlays, and active step banners to make the agent actions feel truly alive.
Provide rich mocked data for test suites, test runs, bug findings, and console/network logs so every screen feels populated and functional immediately.
Implement the 3-pane resizable workbench layout with the bottom execution scrubber timeline.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, tab, input, and panel for robust test coverage.
